news.title: From the development team
news.summary: A new home for your adventure.
news.body:
Welcome to the Alestia Online launcher. Browse news and release notes while your game downloads.

## Stay informed
News, patch notes and artwork can now be published independently of game updates.

## Ready for your adventure
Your download continues while you browse these pages.
